scope.note: Extension-only. Extends the single 'Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis' disease created by the ALS Production Knowledge Manifest v1 (PR #43, merged) with only what is genuinely missing.

already_present_verified.note: Every requested ALS finding/symptom/nutritional-impact/hospice-eligibility-support item was verified already present in PR #43 under an identical name. No duplicate concept was created for any of these.

mapping.existing_concept: Critically Impaired Breathing Capacity (FINDING, already present)
Dependence On Ventilatory Support (FINDING, already present)
PPS Less Than 70 Percent (HOSPICE_ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT, already present)
KPS Less Than 70 Percent (HOSPICE_ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT, already present)

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Aspiration Pneumonia
new_concepts.description: Recurrent aspiration pneumonia is a recognized life-threatening complication of ALS-related dysphagia and supports documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Upper Urinary Tract Infection
new_concepts.description: Recurrent upper urinary tract infection (e.g. pyelonephritis) is a recognized life-threatening complication supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Sepsis
new_concepts.description: Sepsis is a recognized life-threatening complication of advanced ALS supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Stage 3-4 Pressure Ulcers
new_concepts.description: Stage 3-4 pressure ulcers are a recognized complication of advanced immobility in ALS supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Recurrent Fever After Antibiotic Therapy
new_concepts.description: Recurrent fever despite antibiotic therapy is a recognized complication supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review.

new_concepts.name: Enteral Feeding Declined
new_concepts.description: Patient/surrogate decision to decline artificial (enteral/PEG) feeding in the setting of ALS-related dysphagia supports documentation of disease trajectory. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

new_concepts.name: Ventilatory Support Declined
new_concepts.description: Patient/surrogate decision to decline mechanical ventilatory support in the setting of ALS-related respiratory insufficiency supports documentation of disease trajectory. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

functional_assessment_linkage.description: Links ALS's existing PPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's PPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

Links ALS's existing KPS Less Than 70 Percent hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's KPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

trend_indicators.name: PPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Palliative Performance Scale score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: KPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Karnofsky Performance Status score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Vital Capacity Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current forced vital capacity measurement, tracked across recertification periods to document respiratory decline.

trend_indicators.name: Weight Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current weight, tracked across recertification periods to document nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Speech Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current speech intelligibility, tracked across recertification periods to document bulbar decline.

trend_indicators.name: Swallowing Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current swallowing function, tracked across recertification periods to document bulbar and nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Respiratory Support Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current respiratory support requirement (e.g. none, BiPAP, ventilator), tracked across recertification periods to document respiratory decline.

trend_indicators.name: Complication History Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency/severity of major complications (aspiration pneumonia, urinary tract infection, sepsis, pressure ulcers, recurrent fever), tracked across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Narrative Trend
trend_indicators.description: Free-text nurse narrative summarizing overall clinical decline across recertification periods, supporting but never replacing physician-supported prognosis determination.
